scope.summary: Component-scoped autonomous dispatch reservations, conservative overlap checks for active PRs and merge groups, safe lease recovery, targeted tests and operating guidance.
implemented: Component-aware and atomically serialized expiring reservations with bounded concurrent dispatch, conflict preflight, renewal and verified stale-lease recovery.
Trusted-base pull_request_target and merge_group conflict checks based on declared ownership, changed paths and shared SQL objects.
Focused concurrency, migration overlap, direct PR, stale lease and crash-recovery tests; operator guidance for owner-only ruleset rollout.

criteria.description: Two disjoint issues can run concurrently without sharing work areas.

evidence.outcome: Disjoint paths and issue evidence reservations coexist; the autonomous queue runs disjoint eligible issues concurrently within its configured bound.

criteria.description: Two overlapping issues cannot be dispatched concurrently even under racing requests.

evidence.outcome: Concurrent reservation writes serialize; a conflicting candidate loses while disjoint areas remain available.

criteria.description: Existing active PR retains ownership and blocks conflicting new work until integrated or safely abandoned.

evidence.outcome: An expired active-PR lease is renewed, and GitHub API failures never reclaim its ownership.

criteria.description: Direct/manual Copilot PRs cannot bypass required coordination at merge time.

evidence.outcome: Trusted PR and merge-group checks are implemented; enforcement requires owner-approved required-check ruleset configuration, which was not changed.

criteria.description: Shared-file conflicting edits are rejected except for the approved single-writer path.

evidence.outcome: Same-file conflicts and direct PR overlaps are detected; existing managed-file and single-writer evidence controls were preserved.

criteria.description: Failed/expired agent run recovery cannot release a still-active PR.

evidence.outcome: Crash recovery marks the run interrupted but retains the active PR lease; unverified or failed API recovery retains ownership.

criteria.description: CI and merge queue handle competing updates without losing work or unsafe force pushes.

evidence.outcome: Merge-group coordination is implemented, but required merge-queue and ruleset configuration remains owner-only and pending.

criteria.description: Targeted tests cover concurrency, crashes, stale leases, overlaps, shared migrations and direct assignment bypass.

evidence.outcome: 24 passed, 0 failed; includes reservation races, disjoint concurrency, crash/stale lease recovery, shared SQL objects, direct PR overlap and component bounds.

blockers: Owner approval and configuration are required before making the PR coordination check and merge queue mandatory.
